scope: 2-layer Cr-Sb2Te3 migration models and the shared 639-candidate static screen

data_policy.group_leakage_policy: one source trajectory belongs to exactly one split
data_policy.excluded_domain: 3D bulk/doped AIMD source; not silently mixed into the 2-layer migration domain
data_policy.deduplication_note: The 600 K source universe is a subset of the Multi-T source universe. Direct concatenation would duplicate trajectories and create split collisions; therefore the canonical all-data release is the deduplicated Multi-T source universe.

environment.mace: 0.3.12 target environment; record resolved version in preflight

existing_families_to_register_separately.note: Compiled models and test logs exist; retain grouped suffix in canonical IDs.
All three grouped OMAT-FT models exist; seed123 must not be merged with the historical random-split ID.
Foundation checkpoints are distinct checkpoints, not random-seed replicas.

historical_exclusion.reason: Different data lineage, foundation status, architecture, or split provenance; retain for historical failure-mode comparison only.

acceptance_gates: dataset hashes and source-group assignments match this manifest
same launch script and environment for all three seeds
seed in log, directory, output manifest, and registry agrees
compiled model exists, is finite, loadable, and supports Cr/Sb/Te
test metrics and model hashes are recorded per seed
639-candidate static screen has exactly one finite result per candidate and model
strict seed variance excludes all historical heterogeneous models
publication_boundary: Training completion is not a DFT correctness claim; any mechanistic claim remains bounded by the MLIP/DFT evidence actually accepted.
